info.title: Arzi API
info.summary: Health-insurance claim audit and appeal decision support.

get.description: Same as /healthz. Google's front end reserves /healthz on *.run.app URLs and answers it without reaching the container, so uptime checks from outside use this path.
Deliberately dependency-free, so a slow database never restarts a healthy container.

schema.title: Response List Documents Api V1 Claims  Claim Id  Documents Get
Response Audit Log Api V1 Claims  Claim Id  Audit Log Get

post.description:
Start an audit. Repeating the request with the same ``Idempotency-Key`` returns the
same run instead of starting another (and paying for another).

schema.title: Response List Citations Api V1 Meta Citations Get

AuditLogEntry.title: AuditLogEntry
AuditLogEntry.description: Append-only record of who did what to a claim (DPDP accountability).

AuditRun.title: AuditRun
AuditRun.description: One pipeline execution. Persisted as its own document; the claim keeps a summary.

CategoryCap.title: CategoryCap
CategoryCap.description: Cap expressed as a room category ("single private AC"); the hospital tariff prices it.

CitationStatus.title: CitationStatus
CitationStatus.description: ``verify`` is rendered as an amber "Verify before filing" badge.

ClaimFacts.title: ClaimFacts
ClaimFacts.description: Everything the rules engine needs, already extracted, confirmed and redacted.

ClaimMode.title: ClaimMode
ClaimMode.description: Where the claim is in its life, which decides which rules can fire.

ClaimRecord.title: ClaimRecord
ClaimRecord.description:
The persisted claim, scoped to one hospital (tenant). Evolve it with ``model_copy``.

``revision`` is the optimistic-concurrency token: a write succeeds only if the stored
revision still equals the one the writer read.

ClaimSummary.title: ClaimSummary
ClaimSummary.description: One worklist row: no patient data, no document content.

Consent.title: Consent
Consent.description: DPDP consent for processing this claim's documents, recorded before any extraction.

CopayBase.title: CopayBase
CopayBase.description: What the co-pay percentage applies to; policies differ, so it is read from the clause.

DeductionReason.title: DeductionReason
DeductionReason.description: The insurer's stated reason for a cut, normalised from the letter's wording.

Flag.title: Flag
Flag.description: One finding. Narrative text is added later, by the explainer, in a separate model.

FlagKind.title: FlagKind
FlagKind.description:
How a flag's amount relates to the totals.

``deduction``: the engine expects the insurer to cut this amount; summed into ``at_risk``.
``advisory``: a risk with no computed cut; the amount is the exposure, not a deduction.
``dispute``: the insurer cut or rejected something it should not have; ``recoverable`` is
summed into ``recoverable_on_appeal``.

InsurerDeduction.title: InsurerDeduction
InsurerDeduction.description: One cut from the insurer's settlement letter; ``line_id`` is None for claim-level cuts.

IrdaiList.title: IrdaiList
IrdaiList.description:
IRDAI Annexure I lists: I is not payable; II-IV are subsumed into room, procedure or
treatment cost and must not be deducted separately.

LineCorrection.title: LineCorrection
LineCorrection.description: A person's correction to one bill line. Omitted fields are left as they are.

LlmCall.title: LlmCall
LlmCall.description: Token usage and estimated cost of one model call, for the run record and the ledger.

Patient.title: Patient
Patient.description: Only the pseudonym reaches the engine; raw identifiers stay in a restricted field.

RedactionSummary.title: RedactionSummary
RedactionSummary.description: What redaction replaced, by identifier kind (counts only; never the values).

ReviewIssue.title: ReviewIssue
ReviewIssue.description: Something a person must confirm before the numbers can be trusted.

RunEvent.title: RunEvent
RunEvent.description: One streamed pipeline event; ``seq`` doubles as the SSE event id for resumption.

SubLimit.title: SubLimit

Totals.title: Totals
Totals.description: ``billed = predicted_payable + at_risk``; recoverable is what an appeal can win back.
